bundle.description: Raw byte budget for the homepage-critical web bundle (index-*.js + __common-*.js from `expo export --platform web`). Baseline captured 2026-07-13 post-phase-2 (#4407/#4408/#4409). Bump budgetRawBytes/warnRawBytes only as an explicit, reviewed change alongside a note on why the bundle grew. 2026-09-07 bump 5,141,545 → 5,300,000: the CI gate had been dead since 2026-07-13 (PR Merger merged Roadie PRs before the gate ran — see .agents/pr-merger/merge.sh GATE_CHECKS) and main drifted to 5,226,496 unnoticed. Measured cause: data/studies/index.js is imported statically from App.js and pulls all four studies datasets (~200KB raw) into index-*.js just to compute cross-links. Once that is lazy-loaded (tracked as a `performance` issue) restore budgetRawBytes to 5141545 and warnRawBytes to 4907839.

homepageRequestGraph.description: Chunk names that must never be requested on initial homepage load. These are explicitly deferred behind scroll (IntersectionObserver) in TopListsSection/AlbumArticlesSection (#4407) because of their size (top10Lists ~830KB raw). Other lazy chunks (SoundLikeGuides, drummerComparisons, etc.) are intentionally preloaded in the background via requestIdleCallback for fast subsequent navigation and are not covered by this check. 2026-09-07 (#7149): the old monolithic `albumArticles` chunk (~10MB raw) was split into one module per /articles/<slug> plus a small `albumArticlesManifest` metadata chunk (AlbumArticlesSection's rail) - both stay scroll-gated, so both stay listed here. The per-slug chunks themselves are named after their article slug and are never requested from the homepage at all, so they don't need an entry.
